dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Jaxx is at risk due to his behavioral concerns. In the care center, Jaxx displays dog and kennel reactivity, including intense barking, growling, snarling, lunging, and attempting to snap at neighboring dogs through kennel bars. He has presented with dilated pupils, hypersalivation, stiff body posture, and high arousal. He has been difficult to redirect with treats when highly aroused. He has recently accepted enrichment, takes treats gently, and liquid treats during kennel side interactions. Jaxx is was noted to be very friendly and easy to handle in space without other animals present. Once around other dogs becomes very stressed. Medically, Jaxx is healthy at this time.

Jaxx came into the care center as an owner surrender due to eviction. In the care center Jaxx has displayed kennel and dog reactivity since intake, including barking, growling, snarling, lunging, and attempting to snap at dogs through kennel bars. He has shown high arousal around neighboring kennels and passing dogs. In the kennel, he has been observed with dilated pupils, hypersalivation, and a tense body. He has shown some ability to approach handlers with a softer body when offered enrichment and liquid treats, though he briefly displays whale eye. Jaxx is available for rescue through one of our new hope partners.
